qualification.details: Assistant Legal Aid Advisor: Bachelor's Degree in Law with 3/1 years experience or Master's Degree in Law with 1 year experience. Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis or with 5 years service in Level-10 or 6 years service in Level-8 in the Parent cadre/Department. Accounts Officer: Qualified in Subordinate Accounts/Audit Service or equivalent. Officers holding analogous posts in organised Central/State Accounts/Audit Cadre drawing pay in Level-10 or with 5 years regular service in Level-8. Superintendent (Legal): Bachelor's Degree in Law with 3 years experience or Master's Degree in Law with 1 year experience. Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis or with 2 years service in Level-7 or 6 years service in Level-6 in the Parent cadre/department. Superintendent (IT): Bachelor of Science or Engineering or Technology in IT/Computer Science/Electronics/Communication/Electrical or Bachelor of Computer Applications with 2 years overall experience (1 year in information security/cyber security). Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis or with 2 years service in Level-7 in the Parent cadre/department. Assistant Accounts Officer: Professional qualifications of Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant / MBA (Finance); OR SAS / equivalent examination of organised Accounts/Audit Cadre of Central/State Government; OR at least five years' experience in handling accounts related work. Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis or with 3 years service in Level-7 or 5 years service in Level-6. Assistant Section Officer: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline. Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis or with 5 years service in Level-6, 6 years service in Level-5, or 10 years service in Level-4 in the Parent cadre/Department. Assistant (Legal): Bachelor's Degree in Law with two years' experience in Legal matters. Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis or with 5 years service in Level-6 in the Parent cadre/Department. Senior Secretariat Assistant: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline. Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis or with 8 years regular service in Level-2 in the Parent cadre/Department. Stenographer Grade 'D': Bachelor's Degree in any discipline. Skill Test norms: Dictation: 10 minutes @ 80 wpm, Transcription: 50 minutes (English) on computer. Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis or with 5 years regular service in Level-2 in the Parent cadre/Department. Assistant Librarian: Bachelor's Degree in Library Science or Library and Information Science with two years' professional experience in a Library. Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis or with 8 years service in Level-2 or 5 years service in Level-3, plus typing speed 35 wpm in English.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NALSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the NALSA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is October 10th, 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NALSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies announced for various posts in the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NALSA Various Posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for NALSA posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for most of the posts, specifically Sl. Nos. 3 to 10, is 56 years.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum qualifications required for NALSA posts?
faq.answer: The qualifications range from a Bachelor's Degree in Law, Science, or Library Science to professional qualifications like Chartered Accountant, Cost Accountant, MBA (Finance), and SAS examination.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the NALSA posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Pay Level-4 (₹25,500 - ₹81,100) to Pay Level-11 (₹67,700 - ₹2,08,700), depending on the post.

faq.question: Q7. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA).

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this NALSA recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is A/02/2025-NALSA.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates apply online for this NALSA recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to The Member Secretary, National Legal Services Authority, 26, Jaisalmer House, Mansingh Road, New Delhi-110011.
